LCDC DBIB Exported Functions

group LCDC_DBIB_Exported_Functions

Functions provided by the DBIB driver module.

Functions

void DBIB_BypassCmdByteCmd(FunctionalState NewState)

Enable or disable command byte bypass in auto mode.

Example usage 

void driver_lcdc_dbib_init(void)
{
    DBIB_BypassCmdByteCmd(ENABLE);
}

参数:

NewState -- [in] New state of command byte bypass. This parameter can be one of the following values:

  • ENABLE: Enable command byte bypass.

  • DISABLE: Disable command byte bypass.

void DBIB_ResetCS(void)

Pull down CS to active state.

Example usage 

void driver_lcdc_dbib_init(void)
{
    DBIB_ResetCS();
}

void DBIB_SetCS(void)

Pull up CS to idle state.

Example usage 

void driver_lcdc_dbib_init(void)
{
    DBIB_SetCS();
}

void DBIB_ResetDC(void)

Put DBIB in command mode.

Example usage 

void driver_lcdc_dbib_init(void)
{
    DBIB_ResetDC();
}

void DBIB_SetDC(void)

Put DBIB in data mode.

Example usage 

void driver_lcdc_dbib_init(void)
{
    DBIB_SetDC();
}

void DBIB_Init(LCDC_DBIBCfgTypeDef *DBIBCfg)

Initializes DBIB interface according to the specified parameters in the DBIBCfg.

Example usage 

void driver_lcdc_dbib_init(void)
{
    LCDC_DBIBCfgTypeDef dbib_init = {0};
    dbib_init.DBIB_SPEED_SEL         = DBIB_CLOCK_DIV_2;
    dbib_init.DBIB_InitGuardTimeCmd  = DBIB_INIT_GUARD_TIME_DISABLE;
    dbib_init.DBIB_InitGuardTime     = DBIB_INIT_GUARD_TIME_1T;
    dbib_init.DBIB_CmdGuardTimeCmd   = DBIB_CMD_GUARD_TIME_DISABLE;
    dbib_init.DBIB_CmdGuardTime      = DBIB_CMD_GUARD_TIME_1T;
    dbib_init.DBIB_GuardTimeCmd      = DBIB_GUARD_TIME_DISABLE;
    dbib_init.DBIB_GuardTime         = DBIB_GUARD_TIME_1T;
    dbib_init.DBIB_WRDelay           = DBIB_WR_HALF_DELAY;
    DBIB_Init(&dbib_init);
}

参数:

DBIBCfg -- [in] Pointer to a LCDC_DBIBCfgTypeDef structure that contains the configuration information for DBIB interface.

void DBIB_SendCmd(uint8_t cmd)

Send command in manual mode.

Example usage 

void driver_lcdc_dbib_init(void)
{
    DBIB_SendCmd(0x09);
}

参数:

cmd -- [in] Command which to be sent.

void DBIB_SendData(uint8_t *pBuf, uint32_t len)

Send data in manual mode.

Example usage 

void driver_lcdc_dbib_init(void)
{
    uint8_t buf[3] = {0x05, 0x08, 0x10};
    DBIB_SendData(buf, 3);
}

参数:

  • pBuf -- [in] Data buffer for sending.

  • len -- [in] The length of the data to be sent.

void DBIB_ReceiveData(uint8_t *pBuf, uint32_t len)

Receive data in manual mode.

Example usage 

void driver_lcdc_dbib_init(void)
{
    uint8_t buf[3] = {0, 0, 0};
    DBIB_ReceiveData(buf, 3);
}

参数:

  • pBuf -- [in] Data buffer for receiving.

  • len -- [in] The length of the data to be received.

void DBIB_Write(uint8_t cmd, uint8_t *pBuf, uint32_t len)

Send command and data in manual mode.

Example usage 

void driver_lcdc_dbib_init(void)
{
    uint8_t buf[3] = {0x05, 0x08, 0x10};
    DBIB_Write(0x09, buf, 3);
}

参数:

  • cmd -- [in] Command which to be sent.

  • pBuf -- [in] Data buffer for sending.

  • len -- [in] The length of the data to be sent.

void DBIB_Read(uint8_t cmd, uint8_t *pBuf, uint32_t len)

Send command and read data in manual mode.

Example usage 

void driver_lcdc_dbib_init(void)
{
    uint8_t buf[3] = {0, 0, 0};
    DBIB_Read(0x10, buf, 3);
}

参数:

  • cmd -- [in] Command to be sent.

  • pBuf -- [in] Data buffer for receiving.

  • len -- [in] The length of the data to be received.

FlagStatus LCDC_DBIB_SetCmdSequence(uint8_t *pCmdBuf, uint8_t len)

Configure command sequences in auto mode.

Example usage 

void driver_lcdc_dbib_init(void)
{
    uint8_t buf[5] = {0x15, 0x18, 0x11, 0x20, 0x26};
    LCDC_DBIB_SetCmdSequence(buf, 5);
}

参数:

  • pCmdBuf -- [in] Buffer address which store command sequence.

  • len -- [in] Command length.

返回值:

  • SET -- Command sequence configuration successful.

  • RESET -- Command sequence configuration failed.

返回:

The status of command sequence configuration..

void DBIB_StructInit(LCDC_DBIBCfgTypeDef *DBIBCfg)

Initialize the LCDC_DBIBCfgTypeDef structure with default values.

Example usage 

void driver_lcdc_dbib_init(void)
{
    LCDC_DBIBCfgTypeDef dbib_init;
    DBIB_StructInit(&dbib_init);
    DBIB_Init(&dbib_init);
}
